reviewer: Claude Opus 5.5 (claude-opus-5-5) — independent reviewer, did not build this video
method: Ran validate_spec / render --sheet --keyframes --layout / layout_check / probe_video / check_determinism; viewed out/contact_sheet.jpg (16 auto keyframes), out/review_seams.jpg (s-0.05, s+0.05, s+0.15, s+0.25 at seams 2.5/5.5/9.5/12.5), out/review_s3s4.jpg (8.4–9.4 s and 11.9–12.3 s close-ups), out/review_mp4.jpg (6 frames decoded from the MP4: n=30,120,246,330,366,440); cross-checked text timing in out/layout.json; checked claims against task.json key_messages / must_avoid.

checks.note: P0 factual error, s3_probs 6.4–9.5 s (also visible in MP4 frame n=246): the four candidate probabilities 好 62% + 热 30% + 冷 20% + 差 9% sum to 121%. A next-token distribution over the whole vocabulary sums to 100%, so the top four can sum to at most 100% — and the on-screen note itself says the rest of the vocabulary also gets a share, which makes >100% self-contradictory. Correct: e.g. 好 52% / 热 21% / 冷 12% / 差 5% (sum 90%, leaving ~10% for the rest of the vocabulary). Secondary (warn-level): s4 readouts '最可能：「，」41%' etc. (9.9–12.1 s) show illustrative probabilities with no 示意 label in that scene (must_avoid: presenting illustrative numbers as real model data); s5 headline 'AI 一次只猜一个词' says 词 although s2 just taught that the unit is a token — acceptable simplification but 'token' would be more accurate. No claim that AI understands/thinks; token IDs are labelled 编号仅为示意 (s2 4.4 s).

Every scene has a visible event matching its storyboard event: s1 title rises + accent underline under 说话 + cursor (2.45 s seam frame); s2 sentence 今天天气真 (2.75 s) splits into 3 boxes, IDs appear staggered (4.00 → 5.37 s); s3 bars grow, 好 framed, others dim, ? slot filled with 好 (8.4 s onward, 9.37 s); s4 row grows 好 → ， → 适合 → 出门 with ? placeholder each step (9.67 / 11.00 / 11.9 / 12.3 s); s5 recap row, 所以, headline, sub, 自回归生成 badge (13.77 → 14.87 s). Minor: in s3 the 好 bar already has its frame at 7.50 s, ~0.6 s before the chime at 8.1 s and before the ? slot fills (~8.35 s), so the 'pick' beat is split in two.

Focus is clear in all keyframes (single big element per beat, others dimmed in s3, accent box on the newest token in s4). Weak spots: s3 disclaimer (8.4–9.5 s) is a 3-line low-contrast caption under the bars and partly below the safe area (V1); s4 '最可能' readout is on screen only ~0.5 s per step and jumps from y≈975 to y≈1142 when the row wraps to two lines at ~10.5 s.

One accent (#FF7A45 orange) + support blue (#5AB4FF) used consistently across all five scenes; same type family and dark ground throughout. No banned effects seen (no particles, neon glow, lens flare, shake, elastic text). Headlines have no trailing full stop. Only style-rule breach is 'text outside the safe area' (s3 note) — already counted as auto V1 fail, not double-counted here.

s5 recap row 今天 天气 真 好 ， 适合 出门 (12.67–15 s) calls back the sentence from s2–s4, but the storyboard motif says the sentence is '开场被提问' — s1 (0–2.5 s) never shows 今天天气真…, so the ending echoes the middle, not the opening. Also the recap row at 13.77 s is small (~caption size) and reads as secondary.
